response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS baseline FROM s), q AS (SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.avg_conf FROM s CROSS JOIN b WHERE s.avg_conf > b.baseline), qm AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS qmean FROM q) SELECT q.brokrepstat, q.avg_conf AS avg_modelconf, q.avg_conf - b.baseline AS diff_from_baseline, q.avg_conf / qm.qmean AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM q CROSS JOIN b CROSS JOIN qm WHERE b.baseline IS NOT NULL AND qm.qmean IS NOT NULL
